data.name: Stunning Fist (Mythic)
data.description: With greater potency and frequency, your fists stun those who stand against you. The DC of your Stunning Fist increases by , and you can use Stunning Fist multiple times during the same round. As a free action, you can expend one use of your mythic power to use Stunning Fist without spending one of your daily uses of the feat.
